credits.title: Sri Sri
credits.overview: He loved a girl with no past and gave her a future... Now destiny returns to take her back, steeped in a forgotten life, buried memories and claims he cannot disprove.

credits.title: The Red Bag
credits.overview: Four women trapped in a deadly human-trafficking empire steal a mysterious red bag and race through betrayal, violence, and relentless pursuit, only to discover the bag holds a secret powerful enough to change everything.

credits.title: Mithra Mandali
credits.overview: The lives of a group of misfit friends become chaotic after one of them falls for a politician's daughter.

credits.title: Beauty
credits.overview: A moving and suspenseful tale of a father's unshakable love. When his daughter suddenly goes missing, his world is turned upside down. What begins as a desperate search soon becomes a gripping journey filled with questions of trust, innocence, and the true meaning of unconditional love. A film that belongs to everyone,

credits.title: Committee Kurrollu
credits.overview: Go back in time and experience a roller coaster ride of emotions with the Committee Kurrollu.

credits.title: Viraaji
credits.overview: A stand-up comic, gynecologist, hotel manager, police officer and a drug addict, among others reach an abandoned mental asylum by a mysterious host, who informs them that they would all be dead by dawn for their past sins and proceeds killing. Will they live to see another day?
